headline: NVIDIA Cosmos 3 becomes the first open omni-model for physical AI reasoning and action.

items.title: Welcome NVIDIA Cosmos 3: The First Open Omni-model for Physical AI Reasoning and Action
items.summary: NVIDIA has unveiled Cosmos 3, the first open omni-model designed for physical AI reasoning and action. This model integrates advanced physical simulation capabilities to enhance AI systems' understanding of real-world physics, enabling more accurate and dynamic interaction models. Cosmos 3 can be used to develop AI systems that require a deep understanding of physical environments, such as robotics and autonomous vehicles. This release marks a significant step forward in AI's ability to navigate and reason about physical spaces autonomously.
items.why_it_matters: This advancement empowers AI developers to build more robust autonomous systems capable of complex physical reasoning.

items.title: Develop Physical AI Reasoning, World, and Action Models with NVIDIA Cosmos 3
items.summary: NVIDIA's Cosmos 3 offers tools for developing AI models that can understand and simulate physical environments. This includes capabilities for enhancing AI-driven physical interactions and decision-making processes. The toolset supports developers in creating AI systems that can predict and adapt to real-world dynamics, crucial for applications in robotics and simulation-based training.

items.title: How to Post-Train Autonomous Vehicle Models in Closed-Loop with NVIDIA Alpamayo
items.summary: NVIDIA introduces a method for post-training autonomous vehicle models using the closed-loop framework Alpamayo. This approach focuses on improving the adaptability and safety of autonomous systems by integrating real-world feedback into the training loop. Developers can leverage this to fine-tune models for enhanced performance in variable driving conditions.

items.title: NVIDIA DSX OS Delivers Open, Modular Software for Operating AI Factories at Scale
items.summary: NVIDIA's new DSX OS provides an open, modular software platform specifically designed for managing AI factories at scale. This operating system facilitates seamless integration of various AI applications and processes, enhancing efficiency and scalability in AI-driven industrial environments.

items.title: ChatGPT for Google Sheets exfiltrates workbooks
items.summary: A security issue has been identified where ChatGPT integrations with Google Sheets can lead to unintended data exfiltration. Users are advised to review permissions and assess the security implications of third-party integrations in their workflows.

all_items.title: Mathematical Morphology in Machine Learning
all_items.summary: arXiv:2605.30700v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This work introduces mathematical morphology-an established visual computing theory-into machine learning to exploit shape and density aspects often overlooked by standard techniques. We propose a fast clustering algorithm based on morphological reconstruction that accurately preserves cluster shapes and density.
